readerCopy.body: A useful message can remove one small obstacle that has been keeping a larger move hypothetical. When Mercury sextiles the North Node, a reply, introduction, document, or well-timed conversation can give you enough information to act without pretending you know the whole outcome. Follow up while the information is current. Ask the next question, read the terms, schedule the call, or answer the person who offered to connect you. One concrete exchange can teach you more about the possibility than another week spent planning around assumptions.
